from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial line item from one company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name this report belongs to")
    line_item_name: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item name as written in the report")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of this line item")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date (e.g., 2024年3月31日)")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is beginning balance, ending balance, or other")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., 元，万元")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_items: list[FinancialItem]
